title: Smoky Beef Fajitas
description: A classic Mexican dish featuring smoky beef, sautéed with peppers and onions, served with warm flour tortillas. Perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until browned. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of peanut oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet, along with the smoky paprika, stew seasoning, and chili powder. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Warm the French bread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing the beef and vegetable mixture onto the warm tortillas.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
Serve with your favorite toppings, such as salsa, avocado, and sour cream.
